hero.title: Umay: Your home's abundance, accounted for.
hero.description: Track everything at home—from pantry staples and electronics to drawer cables and water purifier filters—in one calm, fast, mobile-first workspace.

lifecycleCallout.title: Never Miss a Filter, Battery, or Maintenance Cycle
lifecycleCallout.description: Water purifier filters, toothbrush heads, robot vacuum brushes, or printer cartridges—track remaining lifespan by time or usage, mark replaced in two taps, and auto-deduct from spare stock.
features: Remaining lifespan bar by time or usage (liters, prints, hours)
2-tap replacement log with automatic spare stock deduction
FEFO expiration alerts for pantry and consumables
Automatic shopping list suggestions and printable QR labels

featuresSection.title: Calm, Fast, and Reliable Home Tracking
featuresSection.description: Everything you need at your fingertips without visual clutter.

cards.title: Atomic Stock Movements
cards.description: Every addition, deduction, and consumption is recorded in a ledger so quantities never drift.
points: Low-stock threshold and smart restock suggestions

cards.title: Replaceable Parts Management
cards.description: Track filters, batteries, and consumables linked to their parent appliances.
points: OK / Due Soon / Overdue status indicators
Planned vs actual lifespan and cost tracking

cards.title: Rooms, Cabinets & Custom Fields
cards.description: Find anything quickly with a hierarchical location tree and category-specific fields.
points: Custom fields for cable length, connector, serial no
Instant search via Ctrl/⌘+K command palette

cards.title: Scan, Find, or Print Labels
cards.description: Scan barcodes with your camera for quick stock updates or print QR labels for shelves.
points: Printable QR labels for shelves, boxes, and items
Full CSV & JSON export and import

cards.title: Works Even in the Pantry
cards.description: Cached lists stay readable offline and pending writes sync automatically when back online.

cards.title: Your Data Stays Yours
cards.description: All records are strictly scoped to your user ID and protected with server-side sessions.
points: Full activity log and transparent history

quickRoutesSection.description: Sign in to start managing your home inventory right away.
